fact: For equity trading, Groww charges the lower of ₹20 or 0.1% of trade value per executed order, with a minimum brokerage of ₹5.
If a user places multiple orders in a day, total brokerage can exceed ₹20 because brokerage is charged per executed order.
Groww charges a flat brokerage of ₹20 per F&O order.
Apart from brokerage, trades can include regulatory and statutory charges such as STT, stamp duty, exchange transaction charges, SEBI turnover charges, IPFT charges and GST.
Groww MTF charges interest of 0.041% per day, equivalent to 14.95% per annum, on the amount funded by Groww.
Groww charges 0.1% brokerage per MTF order on the total order value.
Groww lists a ₹20 pledge or unpledge charge per MTF order.
Groww lists 18% GST on applicable charges including brokerage and several other service and transaction charges.
Groww lists an auto square-off charge of ₹50 per position for open intraday positions squared off by the system.
